description: CLK1 (2m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through a home-built 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass filter (designed 163 MHz cutoff), 15 cm of coax, a cheap band-pass marked 137M/140M, then a measured 37 dB pad set

chain.name: 9-pole Chebyshev low-pass
chain.notes: designed cutoff 163 MHz (measured -3 dB point 173 MHz); connected directly to CLK1; screening not recorded

chain.name: LC band-pass 137M/140M
chain.notes: L-C-L-C-L in series with capacitors to ground at each junction; connected after the cable

chain.name: pad set
chain.notes: measured, not the labels: the 27-33-27 ohm T pad (15 dB) in series with the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (really 27 dB), joined with SMA/BNC adapters. Measured together without a filter on 2026-10-31 as 37.4 dB at 145 MHz (36.9 to 38.4 dB from 20 to 180 MHz).

notes: Compare with 2m-chebyshev-lpf-163MHz-37dB (the Chebyshev alone). Same pad set. This chain was measured by mistake when the Chebyshev alone was intended; it is kept as a valid run of this chain.
